usage: Synthetic design references for procedural café generation
limitations: Independent generated perspectives are approximate design references, not calibrated multiview measurements; exact dimensions and spacing are prompt targets rather than measured guarantees.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE landscape architectural interior photograph, eye level 1.5m, 26mm lens: a Nordic bakery café, single rectangular room 50–70 square meters, ceiling 3m. Camera view1: from street entrance looking toward service counter, show overall layout. White wood-panelled counter with white top, espresso machine, grinder, glass pastry display case, register, glass cake domes and bread baskets. Behind counter: shelves with cups, bottles and beans; a menu board with no legible writing. Light wood floor, white and light-wood tables and chairs, calm natural daylight. One wall is glass storefront with an entrance door and window bar with stools. Small tables for 2–4 people spaced at least 0.9m apart; every chair belongs to a table. Cups, plates, pastries, a notebook, chairs slightly pulled out and turned. Restrict decor to pendant/track lights and plants. Real materials, plausible circulation, modest neighborhood café scale. No people, no brands, no logos, no readable text, no collage.

Use case: identity-preserve. ONE photorealistic landscape architectural photo of the SAME Nordic bakery café in the input reference, camera view2. Move camera to beside the service counter and turn it toward the seating and street-facing glass storefront/entrance, a strongly different viewpoint. Eye level 1.5m, 26mm lens. Maintain single room about 60m² and 3m ceiling, same white panelled counter, light oak floor, white/light wood tables and matching chairs, white pendant/track lights, plants, wood floating back-bar shelves. Include the window bar and stools, entrance door and widely spaced 2–4 person tables, at least 0.9m between tables. Every chair at a table or window bar, a few pulled out at natural angles; cups, plates, pastries and notebook. Calm natural daylight. Same spatial arrangement and materials; no added rooms or furniture types. No people, brands, logos or readable text. One image, no panels.

Use case: identity-preserve. ONE landscape photorealistic architectural photo of the SAME Nordic bakery café in the reference. View3: close, eye-level oblique view of the service counter filling most of the frame. Clearly show white wood-panelled front and white top, espresso machine, grinder, glass pastry display, glass cake domes, bread baskets and register; behind them the light wood shelves stocked with white cups, bean bags, jars and bottles, blank dark menu board and white vertical panel wall. Same pale oak floor, white pendant lights, plants and calm window daylight from left. Maintain the objects/materials of reference and plausible 60m² room with 3m ceiling; 26–28mm lens. Leave enough width to see espresso machine AND glass display AND back bar in one frame. No people, logos, readable writing, collage or added rooms.
